# dsh-pen-dev
**Unofficial** pen.dev integration for DeepSeek Harness.

It connects the pen.dev desktop app's MCP server to a DSH session, so the model can design on the
li

ve pen.dev canvas, inspect frames and components, reproduce web pages as editable layers, and use
pe

n.dev's own style archetypes. It also adds a small `pen-dev` skill that teaches the canvas
workflow
and points at pen.dev's authoritative `read_skill` documentation.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by pen.dev. `pen.dev` and its desktop app are their authors'
propert
y; this package ships no pen.dev binaries — it locates the MCP server inside an installed app.
## What you get
| Tool | Use |
| `mcp__pen__get_app_state` | Active document, selection, top-level frames, components, browser stat

e |
| `mcp__pen__read_skill` | pen.dev's own canvas API docs (`execute`, schema, guides) |
| `mcp__p

en__execute` | Run canvas operations against the open `.pen` document |
| `mcp__pen__get_style` | Lo

ad visual style archetypes (fonts, colors, imagery) |
| `mcp__pen__browser` | Open a real site in th
e app's browser, reproduce it as editable layers |
Plus the bundled `pen-dev` skill.
## Requirements
- **DeepSeek Harness** with the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` plugin available. Developed and tested

against DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`.
- **pen.dev desktop app** installed. Developed and tested with Pen 1.2.19

on macOS (arm64).
The app ships its MCP server at
`Pen.app/Contents/Resources/app.asar.unpacked/out
/mcp-server-<platform>-<arch>`.

## How this relates to the official pen.dev MCP config
pen.dev documents the desktop integration as:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

This bundle mounts exactly that server: same binary, same `--app desktop`, same five tools
(`browser
`, `execute`, `get_app_state`, `get_style`, `read_skill`). On top of the minimal config it:

- locates the binary by probing `/Applications`, `~/Applications`, `/opt`, and (on Windows)
`%LOCALA

PPDATA%\Programs`, so a non-standard install works without editing config files
- passes `--agent de

epseekHarness` so the pen.dev app can tell this connection apart from Claude Code
or Codex; override

it with `PEN_MCP_AGENT`
- forwards `PEN_MCP_CONVERSATION_ID` as `--conversation_id`
- raises the pe
r-call timeout to 120 s, because `execute` and `browser` can exceed the 60 s default
`--enable_spawn_agents` is off by default: it would let pen.dev start its own agents outside DeepSee

k
Harness. Set `PEN_MCP_ENABLE_SPAWN_AGENTS=1` to enable it deliberately.
The `@pencil.dev/cli` npm package ships a *different* MCP server build — nine `filePath`-based tools

for its headless `.pen` editor. It is not a drop-in replacement for this integration: against the
d

esktop app that server's IPC methods are not implemented (`No handler found for method
'get-editor-s

pp that server's IPC methods are not implemented (`No handler found for method
'get-editor-state'`).
## Configuration
| Variable | Default | Meaning |
| `PEN_MCP_BIN` | — | Absolute path to the pen.dev MCP server binary. Use it for a non-standard inst

all or another platform. |
| `PEN_APP_PATH` | auto-detected | Absolute path to the pen.dev app bundl

e, when detection misses it. |
| `PEN_MCP_AGENT` | `deepseekHarness` | `--agent` value the pen.dev a

pp sees for this connection. |
| `PEN_MCP_CONVERSATION_ID` | — | Forwarded as `--conversation_id`. |
| `PEN_MCP_ENABLE_SPAWN_AGENTS` | off | `1` or `true` passes `--enable_spawn_agents` (adds a `spawn

_agents` tool). |
| `PEN_MCP_SERVER_NAME` | `pen` | MCP namespace, i.e. the `mcp__<name>__*` prefix.

gents` tool). |
| `PEN_MCP_SERVER_NAME` | `pen` | MCP namespace, i.e. the `mcp__<name>__*` prefix. |
The binary path is computed when the profile activates. The patch probes the usual install roots wit

h
`node:fs`, so `PEN_APP_PATH` is only needed when the app lives somewhere unusual. If nothing is
fo

und, mcp-client reports the spawn failure, adds no tools, and the rest of the harness keeps
working.
## Notes and caveats

- `.pen` files are encrypted. Only the MCP tools can read or write them — never open them with
files

ystem tools.
- The tools edit the document the user is looking at. Treat `execute` as a visible, des

tructive
action.
- One editor per canvas at a time: if another agent (for example Claude Code) is al

so connected to
Pen, avoid having both write simultaneously.
- `PEN_MCP_BIN` requires the enclosing

app (or a launcher that sets the variable) to pass it
through. On macOS, GUI apps do not inherit you

r shell environment; `PEN_APP_PATH` exists mainly
for launchers that do.
- Windows/Linux: the path p

robe understands the usual Electron layouts, but only macOS is tested;
`PEN_MCP_BIN` always wins whe

nderstands the usual Electron layouts, but only macOS is tested;
`PEN_MCP_BIN` always wins when set.
## Plan limits
